title: EverList Data Processing Agreement (Template v1.0)

parties.controller: The partner entity integrating EverList services (or, for direct users: EverList acts as controller under /privacy).
parties.processor: EverList (operator: Nico Ernst Schlager, 7432 Oberschuetzen, Austria; contact legal@everlist.network)

subject_matter: Processing of personal data contained in listings, bookings, account identifiers and support communications, to the extent EverList processes such data on the partner's documented instructions (partner-as-controller integration mode, partner terms s.3).
duration: For the term of the partner agreement plus legally required retention periods.
nature_and_purpose: provision of the hub API, search, booking, checkout and escrow status services
provision of the MCP/agent integration faces
data_categories: account identifiers and authentication material (hashed credentials, tokens server-side)
listing and booking content as entered by users
processing_instructions: Documented instructions are these terms plus the partner agreement; additional instructions require written agreement. EverList informs the controller if an instruction infringes data protection law.
confidentiality: All persons authorized to process data are bound by confidentiality obligations.
security_measures: transport encryption (TLS) for all public endpoints
credentials server-side only; secrets never embedded in public artifacts (leak-gated ship pipeline)
least-privilege service users on the production host
fail-closed honesty gates on payment and escrow surfaces
regular offsite encrypted backups with verified restore procedure

subprocessors.objection_right: Controller may object on reasonable data-protection grounds; parties work out an alternative or the affected processing is dropped.

current.name: AI enrichment providers (listing keyword enrichment, fail-open, no blocking dependency)
current.role: transient prompt processing of listing text snippets
current.note: Provider chain is configurable; current defaults include OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenAI API, OpenRouter, an operator-proxied Venice endpoint) and Z.AI via proxy. Confirmed list is published at each DPA signature date.

current.name: Anthropic (Claude Managed Agent face, partner-owned key)
current.note: Applies only to the Claude agent surfaces; key custody is the agent operator's.

current.name: OpenAI (ChatGPT plugin surface)
current.note: Processing occurs on OpenAI's side under their terms; EverList receives only the API traffic.

current.name: Hosting provider (EU VPS)
current.note: EU datacenter; provider named in the signed DPA annex.

current.name: Email delivery (transactional notifications)
current.note: Provider named in the signed DPA annex.

subprocessor_list_honesty: The list above reflects the code as of 2026-11-16 (enrich.py provider chain; agent faces). It is finalized per-partner at signature; nothing here is invented.
audits: Controller may audit EverList's processing annually on reasonable notice; EverList provides its latest internal security review summary and (when commissioned) pen-test summary letter.
assistance: EverList assists the controller with data-subject requests and breach notifications without undue delay.
deletion_return: On termination, data is returned or deleted per the partner agreement; escrow/ledger records subject to legal retention are retained only as required.
transfers: EU/EEA hosting; any third-country transfer is covered by Standard Contractual Clauses and named in the annex.
note: Template for partner signature; not legal advice. Alignment: GDPR Art. 28 (processor terms), EverList AGB v2.1.
